package_2a_scope_note: Package 2A. Layer assignment and dependency-boundary enforcement only. Does not wire canonical risk services and does not change execution behavior.

composition_root.note: core/application.py is the sole authorized cross-layer composition point (ADR-0001). It may construct services from any layer; this is the documented composition-root exception to the layer dependency rules.

L0.name: CROSS_CUTTING
L0.description: Pure sanitization utilities with no domain, infrastructure, or application knowledge.

L1.name: DOMAIN_CONTRACTS
L1.description: Domain vocabulary, value objects, and contracts. No I/O.

L2.name: INFRASTRUCTURE_ADAPTERS
L2.description: Concrete adapters, persistent stores, journals, event bus implementations, and external service integrations.

L3.name: APPLICATION
L3.description: Composition, lifecycle, orchestration, and execution authority. May consume research/intelligence proposals but owns all execution decisions.

L4.name: RESEARCH_INTELLIGENCE
L4.description: Produces proposals and evidence. Must never own execution authority or reach execution internals directly (research cannot trade).

L5.name: PRESENTATION
L5.description: Presentation layer. Runtime objects must be supplied by injection, not direct construction of application/infrastructure internals.

L3 rather than L5 because it owns process lifecycle rather than presentation, and because the dependency direction is the permitted one -- an entry point may know its presentation adapter (L3 -> L5), while the reverse (L5 -> L3) stays forbidden, which is what keeps web_app.py itself free of runtime construction

research/** is L4 research/intelligence (ADR-0009). research/ holds a stronger invariant than L4 itself: research/__init__.py promises no connection to the Atlas runtime, which is enforced as zero first-party imports outside research/ by tests/test_research_isolation.py -- stricter than L4's stdlib+L0+L1 allowance, and stricter than find_forbidden_edges, which exempts TYPE_CHECKING-guarded imports. This rule is inert today: compute_module_layers iterates only the runtime closure, and research/** is reachable from no entry point, so it assigns no module and leaves module_layers unchanged. It is recorded in advance so the classification is a decision on the record rather than one made under pressure the day research/ is first wired in (W1, ADR-0009)
